items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m in Woodstock speaking with Karl Berger. Thanks for having me in your house. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh you’re most welcome.

ctx.x: Karl was interviewed in Woodstock, New York, on August 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. Karl’s wife Ingrid participated briefly in the interview.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m in Woodstock speaking with Karl Berger. Thanks for having me in your house.
